en: Black‑and‑white view of a European town square or main street. On the right stands a substantial two‑storey civic building with a steep tiled roof, dormer windows, and a small tower; it resembles a town hall or administrative office. A stairway with a gabled porch leads to the main entrance. In the foreground to the left is a tall stone monument or war memorial topped by a large eagle sculpture with wings partly spread. The base of the monument carries multiple plaques and inscriptions. Behind it a tree‑lined street recedes into the distance with several smaller traditional houses. The lower edge of the image shows torn paper, consistent with an old postcard or photographic print. Some faint German text appears on the monument but is not fully legible.
